batch_needed.value:
status in 
('requested','reviewing','waitlisted','declined','cancelled') or batch_id is 
not null

has_owner.name: has_owner
has_owner.value:
booking_id is not null or batch_id is not null 
or type = 'payment_proof'

issued_has_due.name: issued_has_due
issued_has_due.value: status = 'draft' or due_at is not null

sport_required.name: sport_required
sport_required.value: kind = 'luxury' or sport is not null

manual_has_recorder.name: manual_has_recorder
manual_has_recorder.value:
method <> 'manual_transfer' or 
recorded_by is not null

traveler_needs_booking.name: traveler_needs_booking
traveler_needs_booking.value:
traveler_id is null or booking_id 
is not null

admin_has_password.name: admin_has_password
admin_has_password.value:
role <> 'admin' or password_hash is 
not null

public.batch_seat_counts.definition:
select b.id as batch_id,
       b.capacity,
       count(bt.id) filter (where bk.status = 'offered')                  as 
held,
       count(bt.id) filter (where bk.status in ('confirmed','completed')) as 
confirmed,
       b.capacity - count(bt.id) filter (where bk.status in 
('offered','confirmed','completed')) as remaining
from batches b
left join bookings bk          on bk.batch_id = b.id
left join booking_travelers bt on bt.booking_id = bk.id and bt.removed_at is 
null
group by b.id
public.batch_seat_counts.name: batch_seat_counts
